'''Eftichios Bitsakis''' ({{langx|el|Ευτύχης Μπιτσάκης}}; 24 August 1927 – 19 August 2025) was a Greek philosopher.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=19 August 2025|title=Έφυγε από τη ζωή ο μαρξιστής φιλόσοφος σ. Ευτύχης Μπιτσάκης σε ηλικία 98 ετών|url=https://prin.gr/2025/08/mpitsakis/|trans-title= |work=PRIN|language=Greek|location= |publisher= |access-date=25 August 2025}}</ref>

A longtime professor at the [[University of Ioannina]], he was a member of the [[United Panhellenic Organization of Youth]] during the [[Greek Resistance]]. He earned a [[Doctor of Philosophy]] from the [[University of Paris]] and a [[Habilitation#France|Docteur d'État]] from [[Paris 8 University]] in 1976.<ref>{{cite book |last=Bitsakis|first=Eftichios|date=1976|title=Le problème du déterminisme en physique|url= |trans-title= |language=French|location=Paris|publisher=Paris 8 University|page= |isbn= |access-date=}}</ref> He also notably taught at the [[Collège de France]].

Bitsakis died in [[Athens]] on 19 August 2025, at the age of 97.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=19 August 2025|title=Πέθανε ο Ευτύχης Μπιτσάκης|url=https://www.newsbeast.gr/greece/arthro/12518708/pethane-o-eftychis-bitsakis|trans-title= |work=Newsbeast.gr|language=Greek|location= |publisher= |access-date=25 August 2025}}</ref>
